mods.reason: Bayonetta 3 loads one mod that you pick in its launcher from a mods folder next to its work folder, and Graft can't manage that folder yet.

files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Bayonetta 3.
files.detail: Play opens this app. It's named Bayonetta 3.app, and MacNativeGames builds it in games/by3 in your MacNativeGames folder, or copies it to /Applications or ~/Applications when you install it. The app is small: it runs the game from the work folder it was built from, so keep that folder where it is.

files.label: Base game
files.summary: Your copy of the game itself: the base game NSP you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: MacNativeGames merges its data with the update's to build the game app. Reading it needs the keys from your Switch.

files.label: Update
files.summary: Your copy of the game's 1.2.0 update: the NSP file you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: The game's code comes from this update, and most of its data too.

files.label: Work folder
files.summary: The folder MacNativeGames worked in when it built the game app.
files.detail: It's named BY3_build inside games/by3 in your MacNativeGames folder unless you chose another name when building. The game app records where it is and runs the game from it.
